games.title: Drift Circuit
games.controls: Enter: Start/restart; Left/Right: steer; Z (A): boost; X (B): brake; Shift (Select): title.
games.goal: Finish a 3600-metre time trial within 40 seconds. Dodge traffic and stay inside the road; three hits end the round.
games.learn: A changing road centre, collision rectangles, a fixed frame clock and a three-speed car create a time trial.
games.inspector_hint: CPU shows ARM7TDMI execution. Memory: EWRAM 0200003C holds distance; 02000018 holds lives. Video uses Mode 4 page flipping.

games.title: Cloud Pilot
games.controls: Enter: Start/restart; Up/Down: fly; Z (A): speed up; Shift (Select): title.
games.goal: Fly through 24 moving gates before the 55-second timer expires. Three wall collisions end the round.
games.learn: Recycled obstacle slots, scrolling scenery and gap collision checks make a compact flying course.
games.inspector_hint: Memory: EWRAM 02000010 holds gates cleared; 02000020 holds height. Video shows the Mode 4 palette and active page.

games.title: Prism Break
games.controls: Enter: Start/restart; Left/Right: paddle; Z (A): launch; Shift (Select): title.
games.goal: Break all 24 coloured bricks in 100 seconds. Aim the ball with the paddle edge. You have three balls.
games.learn: Ball velocity reflects from walls and the paddle; a 24-cell array tracks remaining bricks.
games.inspector_hint: Memory: brick flags begin at EWRAM 0200004C; ball x/y at 020000AC/B0. Audio shows real PSG music and collision tones.

games.title: Tiny Tactics
games.controls: Enter: Start/restart; Arrows: move one tile; Z (A): attack within 2 tiles; X (B): select enemy; Shift (Select): title.
games.goal: Defeat three sentries with nine health points and at most 40 turns. Every successful move or attack lets surviving enemies act.
games.learn: A small turn-based state machine combines board occupancy, attack range, enemy movement and health.
games.inspector_hint: Memory: EWRAM 02000018 is health; 02000048 is turns used; three enemy records begin at 020000AC. No turn passes when viewing Inspector.

games.title: Parcel Dash
games.controls: Enter: Start/restart; Arrows: move; Z (A): pick up/drop parcel; X (B): slow walk; Shift (Select): title.
games.goal: Pick up at POST and deliver to the gold address. Complete five deliveries in 60 seconds while avoiding three traffic hazards.
games.learn: Pickup and delivery states, waypoint arrays and moving hazard rectangles form a delivery score attack.
games.inspector_hint: Memory: EWRAM 02000044 is the carrying flag; 02000040 is the address index; 02000010 counts deliveries. Audio shows pickup/delivery tones.
